product.name: 20 Litre Dehumidifier with Ioniser Continuous Drainage Hose and Sleep Mode
product.description:
The PureMate PM 465 is a portable 20 litre per day dehumidifier that delivers exceptional de-humidification with all the lasting performance you would expect from such a global brand. It’s designed to create a healthier and more comfortable environment for houses with up to 5 bedrooms by removing the excess moisture and humidity that can encourage the growth of common allergens and cause damage and staining to your furnishings. It reduces humidity levels, making your home less hospitable to allergens such as dust mites, mold, and mildew therefore reduce irritation to your skin and your respiratory system, allowing you to breathe easier and feel comfortable in your home.

Dehumidifier with air purifier can even use this quality dehumidifier to significantly reduce the drying time of damp laundry on a radiator or towel rail. A less humidly environment in your home means clothing will dry faster, breads and cereals will remain fresh longer without getting stale, and you won’t find signs of rust or corrosion on things like computer equipment, electronics, and tools.

product.name: VonHaus 12L/Day Dehumidifier, 24 Hr Timer, Continuous Drainage, for Damp/Condensation, Laundry Drying, Mould/Smell Control
product.description:
Decreased humidity, increased comfort.
VonHaus 12L Portable Dehumidifier with Handle & Drain Hose
Streamline laundry day with the VonHaus 12L dehumidifier, drying clothes up to 50% faster. The guiding handle makes it the ideal dehumidifier for bedroom, kitchen or utility room use. Use the drain hose for continuous drainage, and rest assured: the auto shut-off prevents spills!

Energy Efficient Dehumidifier with 3 Modes | Dehumidifiers for Drying Clothes
From drying clothes with laundry mode to tackling excess moisture with auto mode to improving air quality overnight with sleep mode, this room dehumidifier adapts to your needs. With a humidity sensor and 12L daily extraction rate, you can monitor humidity levels with the smart colour-coded digital display. More than a dehumidifier for clothes drying, the built-in filter makes it the ultimate 2-in-1 air purifier and dehumidifier. When not in use, use the 2L water tank as neat cable storage.

Low Energy Dehumidifier
Running costs as low as 6p per hour*.	
*Calculated using the April 2025 UK price cap electricity rate of 0.27p per kWh.

Moisture Free Home
The 2L tank removes up to 12L of water per day.
The air dehumidifier’s filter reduces allergens as well as humidity levels, ensuring a fresher home.

Offers continuous drainage in humid environments.
Use the dehumidifier with drain hose for ultimate stress-free humidity extraction. No tank emptying!

Smart LED Display

product.name: Fullex Kinetica+ K4 3-Star Keyed-Alike Euro Cylinders - Chrome, 50/45 (95mm), 2 Extra (7 total)
product.description: Pair of high security TS007 3-Star Kinetica+ keyed-alike euro cylinders combining advanced anti-snap, anti-bump, anti-drill, anti-pick and anti-plug pull protection with its revolutionary anti-tilt cam and sprung anti-grip drive bar. Recognised as leading the field in euro cylinder security, Kinetica+ holds Secured by Design accreditation and provides outstanding resistance against lock-snapping attacks. Kinetica+ uses a variety of specially engineered, hardened steel anti-bump, drill, and pick pins, whilst its core is reinforced by a super-strong strengthening bar that ensures a robust and durable lock. Lock snapping is a huge concern, so Kinetica+ combines several defensive mechanisms. A sacrificial cut ensures the cylinder snaps in front of the vulnerable cam area, and at the moment of failure, an anti-grip drive bar springs forward, and is stopped by dual attack rods that fire sideways. The rotating cam moves independantly, and stops when its outer defence ring hits the barrels. Dual attack rods limit the space attacker can work in, making it impossible to push the drive bar backwards to release the cam. The attacker will also fail to grab the drive bar, due to the bars tapered anti-grip ends. Leaving no way of manipulating or removing the cam. An innovative anti-tilt mechanism prevents the cam section from lowering when the cylinder is snapped, reducing further the space an attacker has to manipulate the mechanism. Following a snap attack, Kinetica+ leaves the lock protected on the outside, and operational on the inside. IMPORTANT SIZE INFORMATION: Kinetica+ cylinder size is represented with the external measurement first, and internal measurement second. Size should be measured from face of cylinder to centre of screw hole. If your cylinder measures 35mm from outside face to centre of screw hole, and 45mm from centre of screw hole to inside face (80mm overall), then you should order a 35/45 (80mm) cylinder.

product.name: SHPELEC 6mm Twin and Earth Cable 6242Y Grey, 2m - Cooker & Shower Circuit Wire, BASEC Approved
product.description:
SHPELEC 6242Y twin and earth cable, 6mm², supplied as one continuous 2m coil. Grey flat T&E for the fixed wiring of dedicated high-current circuits in the home, such as electric cookers, hobs and smaller electric showers.

Which size do you need? 6mm² is commonly used for cooker circuits and smaller electric showers. Larger showers, long cable runs or cable buried in insulation often need 10mm². Socket circuits normally use 2.5mm². Always size the cable from the circuit design or the appliance's installation instructions - never use a smaller size.

Construction: two 6mm² stranded copper conductors (brown and blue) and a 2.5mm² bare copper earth (CPC), PVC insulated with a grey PVC sheath. Max. overall size 7.8 x 15.0mm. Rated 300/500V; minimum operating temperature -15°C, maximum conductor temperature 70°C. Max. conductor resistance at 20°C: 3.08 ohm/km (brown and blue), 7.41 ohm/km (earth). BASEC approved and made to BS 6004.

Current rating: up to 47A clipped direct (BS 7671 reference method C). De-rate for other installation methods, grouping, thermal insulation and long runs.

Installation: fixed wiring in dry or damp locations - clip it to walls or joists, lay it on cable tray or run it in free air where it won't be damaged, and use conduit or trunking where it needs protecting. This is stiff fixed-wiring cable, not a flexible lead. Install only when the cable and the air are above 0°C. Sleeve the bare earth green/yellow at every termination.

In the box: 1 x 2m coil of 6mm² 6242Y twin and earth cable. It is one continuous length, so measure your cable run, allowing extra for terminations, before ordering. Other lengths are available in the length selector. Electrical installation must comply with BS 7671 and the building regulations where you live (e.g. Part P in England and Wales); if in doubt, use a qualified electrician.

product.name: John Guest Speedfit PS Equal Tee 15mm
product.description:
Need to securely connect three pipes of the same size? If you’re using the JG Speedfit push-fit system, you’ll need these equal tee connectors – they can be used with plastic or copper pipes, and it's a far faster way of connecting than using traditional methods.

Installation is simple – you just push the push-fit fitting fully onto the pipe and twist the plastic nut clockwise to lock in place. No tools are needed, which makes it far easier to manoeuvre in tight spaces or to readjust joins. Tool-free dismounting is equally straightforward, by unlocking the nut and pushing the collet towards the body of the fitting. Then, you just need to pull the pipe to release it. 

• Install or demount in seconds, without the need for tools

• Suitable for hot and cold water services

• Can be used on central heating systems and combi systems

• Minimum operating temperature of 20°C

• Maximum operating temperature of 105°C

• 12 bar maximum operating pressure at minimum temperature

• 3 bar maximum operating pressure at maximum temperature

• 50-year manufacturer’s guarantee (T&Cs apply)

• Manufactured to BS EN 7291 Parts 1, 2, 3 and S

• WRAS-approved

• Compatible with Speedfit PEX and polybutylene plastic pipe (inserts required) and copper pipe

product.name: Invena 1/2 Inch Inline Ball Valve Female Thread For Water With Drain Valve
product.description: A ball valve is a valve with a spherical disc, the part of the valve which controls the flow through it. The sphere has a hole, or port, through the middle so that when the port is in line with both ends of the valve, flow will occur. When the valve is closed, the hole is perpendicular to the ends of the valve, and flow is blocked. The handle or lever will be inline with the port position letting you "see" the valve's position. The ball valve, along with the butterfly valve and plug valve, are part of the family of quarter turn valves.  Ball valves are durable and usually work to achieve perfect shutoff even after years of disuse. They are therefore an excellent choice for shutoff applications (and are often preferred to globe valves and gate valves for this purpose). They do not offer the fine control that may be necessary in throttling applications but are sometimes used for this purpose. product.name: 19mm 2 Metre Clear Aquatic/Fishpond Filter, Pump or Waterfall Flexible Reinforced Hose/Pipe, Drainage Hose for Pools and Hot Tubs
product.description: This Clear PVC Corrugated Hose is a durable and flexible solution for moving water, air, or light chemicals. product.description:

product.name: White 1700 x 700 mm Single-Ended Bath with Waterproof Front Panel Matching Black Bath Waste & Curved Black-Profile Bath Screen
product.description:
Create a fully coordinated and contemporary bathroom space with this all-in-one bath, panel, screen, and waste set. Included is a 1700 × 700 mm single-ended acrylic bath, fully waterproof front panel, matching black bath waste, and a premium curved bath screen with matte black aluminium profile.

The bath is built from strong, lightweight acrylic for durability and heat retention, with a smooth, easy-clean gloss finish that is resistant to scratches and UV damage. Its undrilled design allows you to position taps exactly where you want them. The waterproof panel set resists moisture damage, swelling, and warping, keeping your bathroom looking pristine for years.

To complete the look, the 1400 × 800 mm curved bath screen is made from 6 mm toughened safety glass with an elegant matte black semi-framed profile. It features a 20 mm adjustment range (790–800 mm) for a precise fit, an easy-clean coating to reduce maintenance, and a reversible design for left- or right-hand installation. The included black bath waste ensures a perfect colour match for a seamless, designer-style finish.

product.name: Traditional 2 Column Radiator - 1800 x 472 mm - Black
product.description:
Infuse warmth into your home with our cutting-edge traditional style 2 column vertical radiator in black - a perfect blend of timeless elegance and modern efficiency.

Elevate your surroundings with our traditional style 2 column radiator in black!

product.name: Agnite Anthracite Designer Radiator Vertical Oval Column Double Panel Rad 1600x600mm
product.description:
Bring contemporary style and powerful heating performance to your home with this vertical oval tube designer radiator. Finished in modern anthracite (RAL 7016), it creates a striking focal point while complementing both modern and industrial-style interiors.

Designed with a vertical orientation, this radiator is ideal for rooms where horizontal wall space is limited. Its tall, slim profile allows it to fit neatly into smaller areas while still providing excellent heat output.

The double panel oval tube construction maximises heat distribution, delivering an impressive 4859 BTU at Delta 50. This makes it ideal for larger rooms such as living rooms, dining areas or open-plan spaces where higher heat output is required.

Manufactured from durable mild steel with excellent thermal conductivity, the radiator heats up quickly and distributes warmth efficiently throughout the room. The hardwearing anthracite finish adds a sophisticated touch while remaining resistant to everyday wear.

Designed for hot water central heating systems, this radiator includes standard 1/2" inlet and outlet connections to ensure compatibility with most UK heating setups. Wall brackets and fixings are included for straightforward installation.

Conforming to BS EN 442 European radiator standards and backed by a 15-year manufacturer’s guarantee, this designer radiator offers both style and long-lasting reliability.

product.name: AutoSiliconeHoses Straight Reinforced Hose High-Temp High Pressure for Turbo Water Intercooler Coolant Radiator (Black - 850mm)
product.description: Our Silicone Straight Joiner Couplers (SSC) offer a high-performance solution for connecting pipes in coolant, air, water, and turbo systems. Manufactured with a smooth extruded silicone inner and outer layer and reinforced with 3 or 4 plies of polyester braid, these couplers deliver exceptional strength, flexibility, and reliability. Available in internal diameters from 6 mm up to 152 mm and lengths from 50 mm to 950 mm, they cover everything from compact engine bays to large industrial installations. Rated for continuous use at high temperatures and withstanding working pressures of up to 10 Bar (depending on size), they’re ideal for custom builds, replacements, or performance upgrades. Each hose is precision-moulded to ensure a secure fit and optimal flow. Built to SAEJ20 industry standards and compatible with most fluids, these couplers are trusted by professionals for motorsport, marine, automotive, and manufacturing use. Designed to perform under pressure—literally and figuratively.

product.description:
Product Information

    Material: Made of premium stainless steel with suction cup base, corrosion-resistant, waterproof and durable.&nbsp;
    Net weight: 69g per piece.
    Available Colors: Brushed gold, brushed silver, matte black
    Pack Specification: Sold as pack of 2
    Size: Standard wall-mounted suction hook size (round base, vertical peg hook design)

How to Use

    Clean and dry the wall surface completely;
    Peel off the protective film of the suction cup;
    Press the hook firmly on smooth flat surface to squeeze out air;
    Wait a few minutes before hanging items to achieve better adsorption effect. It can be removed and repositioned without leaving marks.

Application Scenarios

    Ideal for smooth tile, glass, acrylic, smooth marble and painted flat walls.Perfect for bathroom, entryway, bedroom and kitchen.Suitable for hanging coats, bathrobes, towels, hats, bags and accessories.

Important Notes

    Only work on smooth, non-porous flat surfaces. Not fit for rough walls, textured tiles, plaster walls and wallpaper.
    Do not hang overweight items to prevent falling.
    Keep the suction cup away from oil, dust and water regularly to maintain strong suction.
    If suction weakens, rinse the suction pad and air dry before reinstalling.
    Not permanent installation; regularly check the firmness of the hook.

product.name: Aqualisa S3BB.HB.U S3 Smart Shower Wi-Fi Display Adj Bath Filler HP/Combi Brass
product.description:
Next generation smart showering is here with the Aqualisa S3 connected shower. In a sophisticated Brushed Brass finish, the S3 looks stunning in any bathroom. The distinctive horizontal controller features a high-definition glass display that automatically wakes up when you approach, and tells you when it reaches your chosen temperature – before you step in.

This S3 offers a completely personal experience, so everyone can enjoy their perfect shower in an instant. Set individual bathing routines for all the household, quickly and simply, on the Aqualisa app. Select yours through the app, or the optional remote control, or your voice, using a Google or Alexa smart speaker. The app monitors water use and allows you to set time limits, as well as adjust the S3’s brightness and mood-lighting.

The S3 controller has three responsive dials and a multi-function digital display, giving you full control from within the shower. Choose your personal routine or simply start the water running. The display shows your preferred flow rate and temperature. The temperature is checked 10 times every second to ensure no hot or cold blasts. Every component has a quality feel, and is designed to enhance the shower experience. The S3 has a built-in diverter to switch between the handset and the bath filler. The height of the handset is easily adjustable with Aqualisa’s clever Pinch Grip™, and it has three spray settings.

The smart technology is housed within the Aqualisa SmartValve™, which can be located up to 10 metres from the shower and is simple to install and maintain. Designed and built to last in Britain, it is backed by Aqualisa’s trusted customer service and a five-year guarantee. Aqualisa fully tests every S3 at its site in Kent before being boxed and shipped in 100% recyclable packaging. Truly smart showering from Aqualisa. 

Suitable for all approved UK high pressure water systems.

product.name: DIYUK W2 Stainless Steel Worm Drive Hose Clips, Adjustable Pipe Clamps, 190-210mm, Pack of 10
product.description:
Need a secure, adjustable grip on a hose, pipe or duct? These W2 stainless steel worm drive hose clips clamp flexible hose, pipe and ducting onto spigots and barbed or ridged fittings: HVAC and ducting connections, domestic and agricultural plumbing, including washing machine drain hoses, and workshop and light industrial hose and pipe fastening. They work as metal hose clamps, hose pipe clamps, stainless steel pipe clamps and duct clamps. This pack contains 10 hose clips in the 190-210mm size.

The band and housing are stainless steel for strong resistance to rust and general weathering, with a zinc-plated steel hex-head screw with a combined slot and cross drive, so it takes a flat-blade or cross-head screwdriver.

The worm drive engages an embossed band 9mm wide and 0.7mm thick for fine, even tightening across the full clamping range, and the slim band keeps the clip low-profile once fitted. The clamping range is embossed on every band, so each size is easy to identify. A recommended tightening torque of 4.0 Nm (approx. 35 lbf in) guides correct fitting.

product.name: Westco 15mm Compression Brass BS Gate Valve - Easy Fit Lockshield Isolating Valve for Heating, No Soldering Needed
product.description: Need to shut off or balance the water flow to a radiator or pipe run without calling a plumber? This Westco 15mm compression brass BS gate valve is a straightforward way to do it. It has 15mm compression connections at both ends, so it fits onto standard 15mm copper pipe with a spanner and no soldering, blowtorch or special tools. It is a lockshield gate valve, which means the cap helps prevent accidental adjustment between services once the system has been set up. That makes it a sensible choice for isolating and balancing water flow in central heating and domestic plumbing systems, where gate valves are a standard fitting in UK installations. The solid brass body is built for strength and long-term reliability, and the gate valve design gives positive shut-off when you need to isolate part of the system for repairs, replacing a radiator or draining down a section of pipework. It is suitable for hot and cold water systems, so it works equally well on heating flow and return pipework and on general domestic plumbing. Whether you are a weekend DIYer swapping an old valve, a landlord keeping a rental property maintained, or a first-time buyer tackling a simple plumbing job, the 15mm compression size is the one to look for on typical 15mm copper pipework. Check your pipe size before you buy: this valve is for 15mm pipe only.

product.description:
The Podium Low Profile 800 x 800mm Non-Slip Square Shower Tray with Black Waste is designed for modern bathrooms, offering a sleek and practical solution for shower enclosures. Included in the box is a square shower tray finished in white with a black waste positioned at the centre edge, providing a contemporary look. This tray is crafted from acrylic capped ABS, delivering both strength and a lightweight design for easier installation-one person can handle lifting and placing the tray. The standing height is 45mm, so it sits low to the floor and suits minimalist styles or accessibility needs. The built-in, textured non-slip surface has been tested and proven to meet strict safety standards, providing reliable grip without the need for separate coatings. Manufactured in the UK, the tray is WRAS-approved and conforms to British and European standards, with a 10-year warranty providing long-term peace of mind.

product.name: Pegdev Detectable Mesh (Sewer Pipe) Durable Underground Service Marker 200mm x 1m
product.description: Pegdev Detectable Sewer Pipe Mesh is designed to provide a clear and highly visible warning for buried underground sewer pipes during excavation work. Manufactured from high-strength, rot-resistant red HDPE, the mesh features an integrated detectable wire and repeated printed “CAUTION - BURIED SEWER PIPE” warning text. The highly visible red colour helps identify buried sewer pipes when the mesh is exposed during excavation. Designed to be clearly visible when pulled up in an excavator bucket, the mesh provides an obvious warning to groundworkers and excavation teams. The integrated detectable wire allows the mesh to be located from the surface, providing an additional method of identifying underground sewer pipe routes before or during groundworks. This durable warning mesh is suitable for contractors, builders, utility companies, landscapers and groundworkers working on construction and excavation projects. The mesh is rot resistant and manufactured from durable HDPE to withstand demanding underground conditions, providing a long-lasting solution for underground service identification. The repeated warning message provides clear visual identification when the mesh is uncovered. Conforms to BS12613:2024 and provides a practical solution for clearly marking buried sewer pipe services during construction, excavation and groundworks. product.name: Clear Braided Hose Kit 51mm (2") Bore 9m PVC Tube Plastic Joiner 2 Stainless Steel Clips Reinforced Air Water Irrigation Pipe
product.description: This kit pairs a 9 metre cut length of 51mm internal diameter clear PVC braided hose with the matching 51mm plastic straight joiner and 2 stainless steel worm drive hose clips, so a run can be extended, repaired or joined straight out of the box. The hose is reinforced with triple polyester yarn between soft PVC inner and outer walls, giving stable pressure handling and good kink resistance while staying flexible enough to route around obstacles. The 3.5mm wall supports a working pressure of up to 4 bar with a 3:1 burst safety factor, and the transparent construction lets flow and contents be inspected at a glance. Operating range is -10C to +65C with a +70C peak, and the hose is compliant with ISO 5774:2016 Type A. The barbed joiner pushes into both hose ends and is secured by the two supplied clips for a leak-free connection. Typical uses include pneumatic tools and air lines, water and irrigation feeds, pond and aquarium plumbing, workshop coolant lines and general light chemical transfer. Supplied under the Hoses UK brand.
